name: Emerging Contaminants
description: Definitions of emerging water, air and solid media-related contaminants; CPCB and international standards for emerging pollutants; CPCB, organization of economic cooperation and development (OECD) and US environmental protection agency (USEPA) method of detection of emerging pollutants (chemicals, metals, pathogens) in air, water and solid media; instrumental methods (laboratory and sensors) for detection of emerging contaminants and category- wise representative contaminants; microscopic and fluorescence methods; sensor-based detection; application of detection methods for characterizing field samples.
